title: The SDK gains more ways to connect and create
summary:
New SDK workflows and upgraded models landed alongside eight community app listings and a safer account check.

SDK 4.3.0 adds device-code authorization for CLI and headless apps, helpers for account keys, and an image-generation helper supporting multiple images and URL or base64 responses. The existing image generator also gains a reasoning option for supported models. OMPC updates its model display names.

The minimax route moves from M2.5 to M2.7. qwen-vision moves to Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Thinking and doubles its listed context length to 262,144 tokens. Both gain new aliases while retaining their existing ones.

The catalog adds DREAMMELD, PollenHours, G-Pai, Akhbaar, What If? Scenario Explorer, Aureon, ManhwaGen, and Deals King & Radar Ai. The README showcase rotates featured apps and updates contributor credits.

highlights.title: SDK device authorization
highlights.text: CLI and headless apps can use a device code to ask users for access, then poll for a token without starting with an API key. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Manage keys from the SDK
highlights.text: SDK helpers can list, create, and revoke account keys, with options for expiry, model restrictions, a Pollen budget, and account permissions. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: More image options in SDK
highlights.text: The new `imageGenerate` helper supports OpenAI-style sizes, multiple images per request, and URL or base64 responses. The existing image generator also accepts a reasoning option for supported models. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: MiniMax moves to M2.7
highlights.text: The `minimax` route now uses MiniMax M2.7, with `minimax-m2.7` and `minimax-m2p7` added as aliases. [Browse MiniMax](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax-m2.7).

highlights.title: Qwen vision gets more context
highlights.text: `qwen-vision` now routes to Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Thinking, with a listed context length of 262,144 tokens and new aliases. [Browse Qwen vision](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-thinking).
